name: Aegis
source:
Aegis is an android, an [Url=https://megamitensei.fandom.com/wiki/Anti-Shadow_Suppression_Weapon]Anti-Shadow Suppression Weapon[/url], sent to observe the protagonist and a member of the Shadow Operatives along [url=/c51882]Mitsuru[/url] and [url=/c52188]Akihiko[/url]. When she was first encountered in Persona 3 and after joining SEES, Aegis operated truly like a robot: her initial personality was simply to obey orders. Due to her humanoid appearance, it allows her to process thoughts like a human, which in turn makes it easier for her to handle a Persona.

After awakening to the Wild Card, Aegis' personality further develops into her current personality of a sweet, gentle, empathetic and strong-hearted young woman with a talent for leadership. She is also very polite to everybody, always using the suffix '-san' when addressing them. In the original Japanese version, she ends her sentences with "de arimasu" prior to developing emotions.

[Edited from [url=http://megamitensei.wikia.com/wiki/Aigis]Megami Tensei Wiki[/url]]

While she can wield multiple personas, she's most commonly seen with [Url=https://megamitensei.fandom.com/wiki/Pallas_Athena]Athena[/url], the Greek goddess of justice, wisdom and warfare.
